title: Partial pauseWithdraw leaves reward debt anchored to pre-withdraw amount -> next claim/withdraw/stake underflow-reverts (account brick)
description: While the contract is paused, pauseWithdraw(partial) (L245) decreases user.amount and totalStaked (L251/L254) but does NOT rebase phUSDDebt/stableDebt. The reward debt remains anchored to the larger pre-withdraw amount. After unpause, any claim/withdraw/stake calls _claimRewards, which computes (smaller user.amount * accPerShare)/PRECISION - (larger debt) and reverts with Panic 0x11 (underflow) at L440/L446. All normal exit paths revert; the remaining staked principal is locked unless the contract is paused again and the user performs a full pauseWithdraw.
impact: Account-level availability/function impact: phUSD+stable rewards become permanently unclaimable and the remaining staked principal is locked against the normal exit paths. Remaining principal is recoverable ONLY while the contract is paused, via a further pauseWithdraw (which requires a live, valid pauser). No theft, no attacker profit, but if no re-pause occurs the principal is permanently stranded.
attackPath: 1. Contract is paused; user calls pauseWithdraw(partial) (L245). user.amount and totalStaked decrease (L251/L254) but phUSDDebt/stableDebt are NOT rebased.
2. Debt is now anchored to the larger pre-withdraw amount.
3. After unpause, any claim/withdraw/stake calls _claimRewards, computing (smaller user.amount * accPerShare)/PRECISION - (larger debt) -> Panic 0x11 underflow (L440/L446).
4. All normal paths revert; the remaining principal is locked unless the contract is paused again and the user does a full pauseWithdraw.
recommendation: Rebase phUSDDebt and stableDebt inside pauseWithdraw whenever user.amount changes (recompute debt = user.amount * accPerShare / PRECISION after the decrement), so post-unpause _claimRewards cannot underflow. Equivalently, settle/zero rewards on pauseWithdraw consistently with withdraw().
